capacity_gross_kwh.notes: GM TechLink: 2020 Bolt EV pack is 66 kWh, new N2.2 chemistry. Same pack carried to 2021-2023 (Wikipedia lists 66 kWh for 2020-2023; GM later quotes it as 65 kWh). Bare nominal capacity, treated as gross.

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: GM figure for the 2022 Bolt EV/EUV is 65 kWh (288 cells, InsideEVs); ArenaEV lists 66 kWh usable for the 2019/2020 car (conflict of 1 kWh); no GM statement of usable vs gross. Years on this pack: 2020-2023 (same cells; no change found).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: "nickel-rich lithium-ion" (LG); GM N2.2 chemistry for 2020 (GM TechLink). Closest enum nmc.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: InsideEVs on the previous Bolt: "The lack of preconditioning meant charging in the dead of winter took even longer." GM TechLink says 2020 DC charging was improved in cold weather (software/chemistry), not a warm-up feature. No preconditioning feature found for 2017-2023.

dc_max_kw.notes: InsideEVs 2022 Bolt EV/EUV: "DC fast charging: up to 55 kW"; Torque News: 2020 55 kW; Wikipedia 55 kW. Standard on the EUV and from 2021 Premier/2022 on the EV.

ac_max_kw.notes: Wikipedia: Level 2 up to 7.2 kW until the 2022 refresh (ArenaEV says 11 kW for the 2019/2020 car: conflict).
